== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=lh-04-the-pilot|An [[Iron]] [[Bishop of the Iron Legion|Bishop]] is a consciousness tasked with the management of specific [[Iron Legion]] [[Hives]]. These entities typically manifest as massive faces constructed from the walls of their environment, utilizing a combination of organic and mechanical parts. Their physical appearance can include eyes made of camera clusters or groups of living eyeballs, and they possess mouths formed from a mixture of [[steel]] and skin. As they are integrated into the [[Hive]], they can manifest physical limbs, such as clawed hands, directly from the surrounding structures. In terms of behavior and purpose, [[Bishop of the Iron Legion|Bishops]] focus on the maintenance and expansion of the [[Iron Legion]] rather than attempting to conquer civilized regions. They generally occupy life-sustaining planets located within [[Dark Space]]. While they are not considered rare on a galactic scale, they are expensive assets. In combat, they demonstrate the ability to adapt to an opponent's magical specialties by implementing countermeasures. They can be disassembled, reconstructed through ritualistic means involving Aetheric components, or even contained within specialized devices.}}
